title: Grilled Halloumi and Cherry Tomato Salad
subtitle: with a creamy herb dressing
description: Charred halloumi served warm over roasted cherry tomatoes, red onion and herbs, on a creamy yoghurt and herb dressing.

steps.text: Blend all the dressing ingredients to a smooth cream.

Roast the tomatoes: heat the oven to maximum. Place the halved tomatoes cut side up on a tray lined with baking paper, drizzle with olive oil, and scatter with thyme leaves, salt and black pepper. Grill for about 5 minutes, until slightly softened with slightly blackened edges. Cool.
Peel the onion and slice thinly, then separate the slices into rings.
Spread the dressing on a plate and top with the onion, basil and tomatoes.
Mix the chopped chilli with some olive oil.
Brush the halloumi slices with olive oil. Grill in a hot ridged pan with no extra oil for 1 minute, flip and grill for another minute. Place on the salad.
Drizzle a little chilli oil over the hot cheese, sprinkle coarse salt over the salad and serve immediately, while the cheese is hot.
